## What if we played the game again and again?

```{=html}
<!--
  Sampling distribution slide for "Insure the Class".
  Each simulation is one game of customers: each claims with probability
  data-claim-prob and each claim costs data-claim-cost. The bars show how
  often each average cost per customer came up across all simulations so far.
  "Show theory" overlays the exact (binomial) chances.

  The number of customers can be changed live in the "Customers per game"
  box; doing so starts the simulations again. Bars cover the likely range
  (expected ± 3.5 standard deviations); when that needs more than
  data-max-bars bars, neighbouring claim counts share a bar. The first and
  last bars also collect anything further out ("≤" and "+").

  Settings (on the .sd div below):
    data-customers   starting customers in one game (default 20)
    data-claim-cost  cost of one claim in dollars (default 600)
    data-claim-prob  chance a customer claims, as a decimal or fraction (default 1/6)
    data-max-bars    most bars to draw (default 20)
-->
<div class="sd" data-customers="20" data-claim-cost="600" data-claim-prob="1/6" data-max-bars="20">
  <div class="sd-main">
    <div>
      <div class="sd-chart" data-out="chart"></div>
      <div class="sd-axis-lab">Average cost per customer in one game of <span data-out="ncust">20</span> customers</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sd-side">
      <label class="sd-stat sd-cust"><input class="sd-in" type="number" min="1" max="10000" step="1" inputmode="numeric" data-out="custin" aria-label="Customers per game"><div class="sd-lab">Customers per game</div></label>
      <div class="sd-stat"><div class="sd-num" data-out="runs">0</div><div class="sd-lab">Simulated games</div></div>
      <div class="sd-stat sd-latest"><div class="sd-num" data-out="latest">–</div><div class="sd-lab">Latest game</div></div>
      <div class="sd-stat sd-key"><div class="sd-num" data-out="mean">–</div><div class="sd-lab">Average over all games<br><span class="sd-exp-lab">Expected <span data-out="expected">$100</span></span></div></div>
      <div class="sd-var">Range <span data-out="range">–</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sd-tools">
    <button type="button" class="sd-btn" data-act="1">Simulate once</button>
    <button type="button" class="sd-btn" data-act="100">Simulate 100</button>
    <button type="button" class="sd-btn" data-act="1000">Simulate 1,000</button>
    <span class="sd-spacer"></span>
    <button type="button" class="sd-small" data-act="theory">Show theory</button>
    <button type="button" class="sd-small" data-act="reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
.reveal .sd {
  --sd-accent: #24476b;
  --sd-mark: #a8322a;
  --sd-gold: #be830e;
  --sd-line: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  --sd-line: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent);
  text-align: left;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  margin-top: 0.2em;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 230px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }

.reveal .sd .sd-chart { display: flex; gap: 6px; position: relative; }
.reveal .sd .sd-col { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.reveal .sd .sd-plot { position: relative; height: 330px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--sd-line); }
.reveal .sd .sd-bar {
  position: absolute; left: 8%; right: 8%; bottom: 0; height: 0;
  background: var(--sd-accent); border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  transition: height 0.2s ease;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-col.is-latest .sd-bar { background: var(--sd-gold); }
/* Expected cost: placed between bars when it isn't a possible outcome (e.g. $100 sits between $90 and $120) */
.reveal .sd .sd-expline {
  position: absolute; top: 0; height: 330px; width: 0;
  border-left: 2px dashed var(--sd-mark);
}
.reveal .sd .sd-expline span {
  position: absolute; top: -1.6em; left: 0; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--sd-mark); white-space: nowrap;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-val {
  position: absolute; bottom: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 2px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-fit {
  display: none; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 0;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--sd-mark); transition: bottom 0.2s ease;
}
.reveal .sd.show-theory .sd-fit { display: block; }
.reveal .sd .sd-k { text-align: center; font-size: 0.4em; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.reveal .sd .sd-axis-lab { font-size: 0.45em; opacity: 0.75; text-align: center; margin-top: 6px; }

.reveal .sd .sd-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.reveal .sd .sd-stat { border-top: 3px solid var(--sd-line); padding-top: 6px; }
.reveal .sd .sd-latest { border-top-color: var(--sd-gold); }
.reveal .sd .sd-latest .sd-num { color: var(--sd-gold); }
.reveal .sd .sd-key { border-top-color: var(--sd-accent); }
.reveal .sd .sd-key .sd-num { color: var(--sd-accent); font-size: 1.3em; }
.reveal .sd .sd-num { font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.reveal .sd .sd-lab { font-size: 0.45em; opacity: 0.75; margin-top: 3px; }
.reveal .sd .sd-exp-lab { color: var(--sd-mark); font-weight: 700; opacity: 1; }
.reveal .sd .sd-var { font-size: 0.5em; }
.reveal .sd .sd-cust { display: block; border-top-color: var(--sd-accent); cursor: text; }
.reveal .sd .sd-in {
  font: inherit; font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; width: 4.2em; color: inherit;
  padding: 0 0.2em; border: 1.5px solid var(--sd-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;
  -moz-appearance: textfield;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-in::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.reveal .sd .sd-in::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }
.reveal .sd .sd-in:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sd-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.reveal .sd .sd-var span { font-weight: 700; }

.reveal .sd .sd-tools { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 14px; }
.reveal .sd .sd-spacer { flex: 1; }
.reveal .sd .sd-btn {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--sd-accent);
  padding: 0.4em 1em; border: 2.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 12px;
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .sd .sd-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); }
.reveal .sd .sd-small {
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.42em; padding: 0.35em 0.9em; color: inherit;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--sd-line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer;
}
.reveal .sd button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sd-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal .sd .sd-bar, .reveal .sd .sd-fit { transition: none; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-AU', { style: 'currency', currency: 'AUD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  var fmt = function (v) { return money.format(v); };

  // Binomial(n, p) chances for k = 0..n, built up in log space so that a
  // large n doesn't underflow
  function binomAll(n, p) {
    var out = [], lp = n * Math.log(1 - p), r = Math.log(p) - Math.log(1 - p);
    for (var k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
      out.push(Math.exp(lp));
      lp += Math.log(n - k) - Math.log(k + 1) + r;
    }
    return out;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.sd:not([data-ready])').forEach(function (root) {
    root.dataset.ready = '1';
    var cost = Number(root.dataset.claimCost) || 600;
    var prob = function (s, d) { var m = String(s || '').split('/'); var v = m.length === 2 ? Number(m[0]) / Number(m[1]) : Number(s); return v > 0 && v < 1 ? v : d; };
    var p = prob(root.dataset.claimProb, 1 / 6);
    var maxBars = Number(root.dataset.maxBars) || 20;
    var MAX_N = 10000;
    var expected = p * cost;
    var chart = root.querySelector('[data-out="chart"]');
    var out = function (name) { return root.querySelector('[data-out="' + name + '"]'); };
    var custIn = out('custin');
    out('expected').textContent = fmt(expected);

    var n, kLo, g, counts, theory, cols;
    var runs, sum, lo, hi, latestK;
    var avgOf = function (k) { return (k * cost) / n; };
    var binOf = function (k) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(cols.length - 1, Math.floor((k - kLo) / g))); };

    // (Re)build the bars for n customers and clear the simulations
    function setup(newN) {
      n = newN;
      custIn.value = n;
      out('ncust').textContent = n.toLocaleString('en-AU');

      // Likely range of claim counts, grouped g at a time to fit maxBars bars
      var sd = Math.sqrt(n * p * (1 - p));
      kLo = Math.max(0, Math.floor(n * p - 3.5 * sd));
      var kHi = Math.min(n, Math.ceil(n * p + 3.5 * sd));
      g = Math.ceil((kHi - kLo + 1) / maxBars);
      var nb = Math.ceil((kHi - kLo + 1) / g);

      counts = []; theory = []; cols = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < nb; i++) { counts.push(0); theory.push(0); }
      chart.innerHTML = '';
      for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
        var a = kLo + i * g, b = a + g - 1;            // claim counts in this bar
        var first = i === 0 && kLo > 0, last = i === nb - 1 && b < n;
        var label = (first ? '≤' : '') + fmt(avgOf(a + (g - 1) / 2)) + (last ? '+' : '');
        var tip = first ? 'Up to ' + b + ' claims: up to ' + fmt(avgOf(b))
          : last ? a + ' or more claims: ' + fmt(avgOf(a)) + ' or more'
          : g === 1 ? a + ' claims: ' + fmt(avgOf(a))
          : a + ' to ' + b + ' claims: ' + fmt(avgOf(a)) + ' to ' + fmt(avgOf(b));
        var col = document.createElement('div');
        col.className = 'sd-col';
        col.title = tip + ' per customer';
        col.innerHTML =
          '<div class="sd-plot"><div class="sd-bar"><span class="sd-val"></span></div><div class="sd-fit"></div></div>' +
          '<div class="sd-k">' + label + '</div>';
        chart.appendChild(col);
        cols.push({ el: col, bar: col.querySelector('.sd-bar'), val: col.querySelector('.sd-val'), fit: col.querySelector('.sd-fit') });
      }
      binomAll(n, p).forEach(function (t, k) { theory[binOf(k)] += t; });

      // Dashed line at the expected cost, at its exact spot on the bar scale.
      // Bar i is centred at i * (bar width + gap) + bar width / 2, with a 6px gap,
      // and holds the claim counts centred on kLo + i * g + (g - 1) / 2.
      var pos = Math.max(0, Math.min(nb - 1, (n * p - kLo - (g - 1) / 2) / g));
      var expLine = document.createElement('div');
      expLine.className = 'sd-expline';
      var bw = '((100% - ' + (nb - 1) * 6 + 'px) / ' + nb + ')';
      expLine.style.left = 'calc(' + pos + ' * (' + bw + ' + 6px) + ' + bw + ' / 2)';
      expLine.innerHTML = '<span>Expected ' + fmt(expected) + '</span>';
      chart.insertBefore(expLine, chart.firstChild);

      runs = 0; sum = 0; lo = Infinity; hi = -Infinity; latestK = null;
    }

    function simulate() {
      var k = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) if (Math.random() < p) k++;
      var a = avgOf(k);
      counts[binOf(k)]++;
      runs++;
      sum += a;
      lo = Math.min(lo, a);
      hi = Math.max(hi, a);
      latestK = k;
    }

    function render() {
      var showTheory = root.classList.contains('show-theory');
      var props = counts.map(function (c) { return runs ? c / runs : 0; });
      var ymax = Math.max.apply(null, props.concat(showTheory ? theory : [], [0.05])) * 1.12;
      cols.forEach(function (col, i) {
        col.bar.style.height = (100 * props[i]) / ymax + '%';
        col.val.textContent = counts[i] ? counts[i].toLocaleString('en-AU') : '';
        col.fit.style.bottom = (100 * theory[i]) / ymax + '%';
        col.el.classList.toggle('is-latest', latestK !== null && binOf(latestK) === i);
      });
      out('runs').textContent = runs.toLocaleString('en-AU');
      out('latest').textContent = latestK === null ? '–' : fmt(avgOf(latestK));
      out('mean').textContent = runs ? fmt(sum / runs) : '–';
      out('range').textContent = runs > 1 ? fmt(lo) + ' to ' + fmt(hi) : '–';
    }

    root.querySelector('.sd-tools').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest('button[data-act]');
      if (!b) return;
      var act = b.dataset.act;
      if (act === 'theory') {
        var on = root.classList.toggle('show-theory');
        b.textContent = on ? 'Hide theory' : 'Show theory';
      } else if (act === 'reset') {
        setup(n);
      } else {
        for (var i = Number(act); i > 0; i--) simulate();
      }
      b.blur(); // keep reveal.js arrow-key navigation working
      render();
    });

    // A new number of customers rebuilds the bars and starts again
    custIn.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var v = Math.round(Number(custIn.value));
      if (v >= 1 && v <= MAX_N) { if (v !== n) setup(v); } else custIn.value = n;
      render();
    });
    // Typing shouldn't trigger reveal.js shortcuts; Enter finishes the entry
    custIn.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Escape') custIn.blur();
    });

    setup(Math.min(MAX_N, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(root.dataset.customers) || 20))));
    render();
  });
})();
</script>
```
